name: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc.
base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF $1,519M - capex $709M - SBC $50M = $760M / 60.3M diluted shares)
moat_justification: Local quarry monopolies: permitting scarcity, 30-50 mile transport economics, proven aggregates pricing power (+6.9% FY25); against: commodity product, cyclical construction volumes, depleting reserves replaced via increasingly expensive M&A.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 6.9x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: High-quality local-monopoly aggregates franchise, moat 7/10, but at $472 (37.5x TTM owner's earnings) it doesn't clear the 15% hurdle — weighted IRR 6.1%, IV@15% $126; clears 15% only at ~$126, ~$95 with a margin of safety.
